Anant Singh Supreme Court Order : bihar ki rajniti se is vakt ki bari khabar samne aaee hai. mokama ke vidhayak aur JDU se nishkasit anant sinh ko suprim kort se jhatka laga hai. dularchand yadav hatyakand men haeekort se mili jamanat ko chunauti die jane ke bad suprim kort ne anant sinh ko 1 disanbar tak sarendar karne ka aadesh diya hai.
Kya anant sinh ko ek bar phir jel jana hoga? suprim kort ke aadesh aur dularchand yadav hatyakand se jure is pure mamle ki jankari ke lie dekhie yah riporta.
